title: 英央行7月维持利率3.75% 贝利称信贷环境收紧
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Today, we've kept bank rate at 3.75%.
segments.zh: 今天，我们将银行利率维持在3.75%。

segments.en: Muncher conditions have tightened for households and businesses since the conflict began.
segments.zh: 自冲突开始以来，家庭和企业的信贷条件已经收紧。

segments.en: We see that, for example, in higher mortgage rates.
segments.zh: 例如，我们看到抵押贷款利率上升。

segments.en: That tightening reflects the underlying economics.
segments.zh: 这种收紧反映了基本经济状况。

segments.en: In particular, the expected increase in inflation from higher energy prices, which needs to be considered alongside whether the underlying disinflation
segments.zh: 特别是能源价格上涨导致的通胀预期上升，需要与国内经济潜在的去通胀是否持续一并考虑。

segments.en: in the domestic economy will continue.
segments.zh: 国内经济潜在的去通胀是否会持续。

segments.en: We will monitor the situation carefully and stand ready to adjust our stance as the evidence and our judgments on the outlook evolve.
segments.zh: 我们将密切关注形势，并随时准备根据证据和对前景的判断调整政策立场。

segments.en: It is our job to ensure that inflation gets back to the 2% target and stays there.
segments.zh: 我们的工作是确保通胀回到2%的目标并保持在那里。

segments.en: And that is what we will do.
